content_sections.heading: About EAMUL
content_sections.text: East Assam Milk Producers' Co-operative Union Ltd (EAMUL) is a milk producers' co-operative that runs under the Purabi Dairy brand. Its office is at Nilomoni Bhawan, Na-Ali, Jorhat - 785001. The notice is issued by the Head-HR of West Assam Milk Producers' Co-operative Union Ltd (WAMUL), Purabi Dairy, R.K Jyoti Prasad Agarwala Road, Juripar, Panjabari, Guwahati-781037.

content_sections.heading: EAMUL Graduate Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The engagement is for the financial year 2026-27 under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS). It follows the Apprenticeship Act 1961, as amended in 1973, 1986 and 2014, and the Board of Practical Training (BOPT), Ministry of HRD, Govt. of India. The notice lists the three locations and four duties side by side for the post. It does not link any duty to a particular location. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: EAMUL Graduate Apprentice Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: B.A B.Com B.Sc Year of passing: Only candidates who passed in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025 can apply. Postgraduates: The notice says postgraduate candidates need not apply. NATS registration: Every applicant must register on the NATS portal and keep the Enrollment ID. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted from the CVs received. Shortlisted candidates are contacted by email only and called for an interview. At the venue, candidates must have their NATS Enrollment ID with them.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is apprenticeship training under the Apprenticeship Act 1961. It is not a regular appointment. The training lasts 1 (one) year, in the financial year 2026-27. Apprentices are placed at the EAMUL Head Office (Jorhat), Darrang or Bokakhat.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for EAMUL Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register on the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php and note your Enrollment ID. This step is mandatory. Prepare your CV and make sure the email ID on it is current, because shortlisted candidates are contacted by email only. Email the CV to [email protected] with the subject line "Apprentice for Graduate level". Send it by 9 November 2026. If you are called for interview, bring your NATS Enrollment ID to the venue.

faq.question: Q1. Which degrees are accepted for the Purabi Dairy Graduate Apprentice post?
faq.answer: B.A, B.Com and B.Sc graduates can apply.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply if I graduated in 2020?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates who passed in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025 are eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Can postgraduates apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice clearly says postgraduate candidates need not apply.

faq.question: Q4. What subject line should the application email have?
faq.answer: Use "Apprentice for Graduate level" when you email your CV to [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. Is NATS registration compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. You must register at nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php and bring your Enrollment ID to the interview if you are called.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: It lasts 1 (one) year and is part of EAMUL's apprentice engagement for the financial year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q7. Where will apprentices be posted?
faq.answer: At the EAMUL Head Office in Jorhat, at Darrang or at Bokakhat. The work covers billing and accounts, field-level monitoring, milk procurement operations and input service activities.

faq.question: Q8. How will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: By email only. Make sure the email ID on your CV is current.
